question: Using the provided 16S rRNA amplicon sequence variant (ASV) table, calculate alpha diversity between sample groups and identify differentially abundant ASVs.

expected_output.description: rows as samples, columns should include sample_id, group, Shannon, Simpson, Chao1
rows as ASVs, columns should include asv_id, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj; asv_id is the ASV sequence hash
